about: I’m a Sydney-based education marketing professional working across international education, with experience in student recruitment, education agent partnerships, admissions operations and campaign development. I also create practical resources on Australian trade qualifications, career pathways and skills-assessment information for students and education partners.
My work brings together education marketing, agency partnerships, student recruitment, admissions operations and campaign development, supported by an analytical approach from my IT studies.

experience.company: Australian Polytechnic College & Monash Polytechnic College
experience.description: Leading student recruitment activity, education-agency relationships and marketing support across sister colleges under one group.
bullets: Achieved 150+ student enrolments within six months through targeted campaigns, agent engagement and lead follow-up.
Manage 30+ domestic and international education agencies, personally signing or reactivating 21.
Represent the colleges at student, community and agency events and partnership meetings.
Develop campaigns, HTML email marketing, course brochures, partnership emails and presentation slides.
Conduct market and competitor analysis to support course positioning and product development.

experience.description: Supported prospective students through course selection, admissions and visa-related documentation while coordinating recruitment operations.
bullets: Converted 100+ prospective students into enrolled clients through counselling, course advice and follow-up.
Prepared 50+ Subclass 500 and 485 visa applications, plus Subsequent Entrant documentation.
Led an overseas team of 8–9 people in Bangladesh, coordinating lead handling and student recruitment.
Managed end-to-end admissions and CoE processing; maintained records in AgentCis CRM and Microsoft SharePoint.

recommendations.text:
I have had the opportunity to know Rakibul and have always been impressed by his professionalism, positive attitude, and dedication. He is someone who demonstrates strong communication skills, a willingness to support others, and a genuine commitment to achieving great outcomes.

From my interactions with him, I have found him to be reliable, approachable, and highly motivated. His professional approach and respectful nature make him someone I would confidently recommend to others.

I wish him continued success in his future endeavours and believe he will be a valuable addition to any organisation.
